blocks.tamil_translation: them (stop them from making a hole in the ship), then they and the other passengers will be saved.” Hazrat Nu'man ibn Bashir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- In this hadith, a ship has been given as an example of this world; among the group travelling in it, the mistake of one section cannot fail to affect the others. The people of the whole world are like a community travelling in one ship; in that ship there are both the good and the evil. If evil overpowers good, it is not only the evil ones immersed in that evil who will be struck by the effect of that harm. The whole community, good and evil, and the whole world will have to suffer the effect of that evil. Therefore, in order to save human society from destruction, it is necessary to stop those who disobey Allah Ta'ala from doing harm; otherwise, the whole community will have to suffer the punishment of Allah Ta'ala.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْعُرْسِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ اللهَ لَا يُعَذِّبُ الْعَامَّةَ بِعَمَلِ الْخَاصَّةِ حَتَّي تَعْمَلَ الْخَاصَّةُ بِعَمَلٍ تَقْدِرُ الْعَامَّةُ أَنْ تُغَيِّرَهُ، وَلَا تُغَيِّرُهُ، فَذَاكَ حِينَ يَأْذَنُ اللهُ فِي هَلَاكِ الْعَامَّةِ وَالْخَاصَّةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني ورجاله ثقات، مجمع الزوائد:٧ /٥٢٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Allah Ta'ala does not punish those who have not sinned because of the sins of some people. However, if those who obey Him do not stop the sinners even though they have the power to stop them, then He punishes everyone, the good and the evil.” Hazrat Urs ibn Amirah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ ﵄ (فِي حَدِيثٍ طَوِيلٍ) عَنِ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ
